description: Defines the InterviewInterviewer entity class which represents a link between an interview and an employee who is an interviewer, used in the recruitment plugin of OrangeHRM. It maps to the 'ohrm_job_interview_interviewer' database table and establishes relations with Interview and Employee entities.

classes.name: InterviewInterviewer
classes.description: Entity class representing a many-to-many relationship between an Interview and an Employee acting as an interviewer. It uses composite primary keys composed of interview and interviewer.
